question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Confess
solution:
The correct answer is: **Acknowledge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Confess**" means admit or state that one has committed a crime or is at fault in some way (कबूल करना).
 
• The correct synonym is "**Acknowledge**," which means to accept or admit the existence or truth of something (मानना).
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Acknowledge**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• "**Veil**" means to cover, conceal, or disguise (पर्दा करना).
 
• "**Dissimulate**" means to conceal or disguise (one's thoughts, feelings, or character) (ढोंग करना).
 
• "**Deny**" means to state that one refuses to admit the truth or existence of (इनकार करना). This is an antonym for "**Confess**".
